title: A Galois extension is Galois over every intermediate field
statement: Let $F\subseteq K\subseteq E$ be a tower of fields [def-pc-field-extension]. Assume that $E/F$ is Galois: it is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension] and normal, meaning that the minimal polynomial over $F$ of each element of $E$ splits into linear factors over $E$. Then $E/K$ is Galois in the same sense. No finiteness assumption is made.
